title: interop B3: harness TLS proxy for mimi-hubd mTLS
description: Per Mark: local TLS proxy (e.g. stunnel) holds a throwaway client cert between mimid PeerClient and mimi-hubd; mimid code unchanged. Script it; throwaway CA/certs generated at run time, never committed.
notes: Haven builds root-level directory URLs as https://{provider_domain}{path} with no port (mimi-hubd/src/lib.rs directory()). Locally the harness must make provider_domain resolve to the proxy/hub (e.g. provider_domain=localhost:<port> if Haven accepts a port there, or a hosts entry); mimid uses directory URLs as given (decision .6.48).
close_reason: Harness at /home/mark/Cache/mimid-haven-xcheck/live (outside both repos): run.sh builds mimi-hubd (CARGO_TARGET_DIR /home/mark/Cache/haven-target), makes a throwaway CA per run, enters unshare --user --map-root-user --net; up.sh starts mimi-hubd (provider_domain haven.localhost, 127.0.0.1:8443, mTLS) and socat on [::]:443 presenting haven.localhost and forwarding with the client cert, sets SSL_CERT_FILE, runs the given command. ./run.sh ./selftest.sh passes: directory via proxy OK, direct no-cert request refused. Unverified: mimid's rustls-platform-verifier honouring SSL_CERT_FILE (curl/OpenSSL only so far); check first in B4. Port 443 + no-port URLs needed because of Haven defect mimid-1wgh.46.1.10.
